    General tips

    How to play Gwen

    Poke with stacked Qs, survive the lanes that beat you early, and out-scale them into teamfights.

    01

    Trading pattern

    • Stack Q first. Auto the wave to 4 stacks before you walk up to trade.
    • Q, then E out. Your basic short trade: leave before they can hit back.
    • Aim the center. The middle of your Q deals true damage.
    • W blocks return damage. Abilities from outside the mist can't target you.
    • Trade on their cooldowns. When their key spell is down, it's a free trade.
    02

    Power spikes

    • Level 6: R gives you real all-in pressure.
    • First item: your biggest spike. Many hard lanes turn here.
    • Two items: you win most side lanes.
    • Skill points: into lanes where you need to dodge, put 3 points in Q, then max E for a shorter dash cooldown.
    03

    Lane and map

    • Let hard lanes push to you. Farm near your tower and give up CS rather than die; XP matters most.
    • Cheater recall. In lanes you win, push 3–4 waves into their tower and reset.
    • Don't leash when you need level 1 priority, like into Irelia or Singed.
    • Ping roams. Riven, Pantheon and Kled love to leave lane.
    04

    Teamfight role

    • Look for 5v5s into late-game duelists like Fiora, Tryndamere, Yasuo and Yone.
    • Mist the backline out. Use W in the fight so their ranged damage can't target you.
    • Tanks are fair game. Your passive hits harder the more health they have.
    • Save R3 until they've used their dash or ultimate.
